workload_prep_guarantee_003.evidence: All secondary school teachers shall be given at least five (5) daily planning periods per week that are equal in length to a class period

workload_prep_minutes_004.answer: Secondary: ≥5 periods/week equal to class period. Other/Elementary: 30-min morning blocks (60 or 90 min total) or 3 days/week (45 or 30 min/day).
workload_prep_minutes_004.evidence: All secondary school teachers shall be given at least five (5) daily planning periods per week that are equal in length to a class period

workload_prep_protected_005.evidence: In instances where a special subject Teacher is not available to provide coverage for a Teacher’s scheduled planning period, the building Supervisor shall: Seek a substitute; Utilize an alternative planning schedule; and/or Implement an alternative planning mechanism

workload_lunch_duty_free_006.evidence: In secondary schools, each Teacher shall have a duty-free lunch period equal in length to a full teaching period... A duty-free lunch period shall not include the supervision of students.
